subject: Portal onboarding: redline capture & PO field enablement (Coupa)
messages:
From: Jane Fisher <jane.fisher@orionhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: procure-admin@orionhealth.com
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood onboarding — MSA redlines + portal requirements

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement is ready to move forward but we've got a couple of blocking items before we can finish vendor enrollment in our Coupa instance:

1) Our legal team returned an MSA with inline redlines (attached: Redlines_Orion_MSA_v2.docx). There are two commercial asks and one audit-log clause we need to resolve.
2) The Coupa onboarding team needs a clear mapping of what Order Form fields Redwood requires at PO time (PO number, remit-to, tax id, PO ACK window, and GL code behavior).
3) We will need to confirm signer routing — our platform requires a designated remittance contact and a separate billing signer for >$250k orders.

Can you confirm the process/timeline for: legal review coordination, providing a field mapping template for our Coupa admin, and the expected handoff for signature? We also want to avoid multiple redline rounds if possible.

Appreciate it —
Jane
Jane Fisher
Senior Procurement Manager | Orion Health
procure-admin@orionhealth.com

Attachment: Redlines_Orion_MSA_v2.docx (docx, 128 KB)

Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — MSA redlines + portal requirements

Hi Jane — thanks for sending this over and for the clear list. Quick plan below and next steps to keep things tight:

High-level plan
- Legal intake: I'll loop in Kimberly (cc'd), our legal ops lead, who will review the redlines and produce a single consolidated response. Expect initial comments within 48 business hours.
- Portal field mapping: Attached is our RW_portal_field_mapping_template.xlsx — please populate with the exact Coupa field names for PO Number, Remit To, Tax ID, GL code, and any custom attributes (e.g., project codes). If you send it back by Monday we can validate mapping against our order form.
- Signer routing: Can you confirm the email for your remittance contact and whether you require a separate billing signer for signatory delegation? If yes, we will mark the order form to route amounts >$250k to the billing signer.

Next steps for this week
1) Kimberly will review MSA redlines and flag any non‑standard clauses.
2) You fill out the mapping template and return (procure-admin@orionhealth.com).
3) We'll schedule a 30m legal/ops sync Tuesday (suggest Tue 8/24 11:00 PT) to go line‑by‑line.

I attached the mapping template and a short PO field checklist (OrderForm_POFieldChecklist.md) to help your Coupa admin. If that timeline is tight for you, tell me preferred windows and we can accelerate.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Redwood onboarding — MSA redlines + portal requirements

Thanks for the ping. I reviewed Redlines_Orion_MSA_v2.docx and captured high‑level positions in the attached PDF (Redline-comments_kimberly.pdf). Summary:

1) Audit-log clause: propose a narrow carve that preserves our telemetry retention policy (we can agree to provide event-level logs for production incidents but cannot commit to arbitrary SIEM access).
2) Commercial asks: one is a payment term push (Net30 -> Net45) — recommend we accept Net30 but offer a one-time 45-day payment milestone for the pilot contract. The other request is a liquidated damages cap change — push back to the standard 3% cap.
3) Signature routing clause: operationally we can support separate billing vs remit signer by adding a metadata flag on the Order Form. Mateo, can you confirm if our order ingestion rejects PO lines when remit-to differs from invoice contact? If so, we should add a line explaining acceptability and suggested field population.

I'll prepare tracked-changes for the MSA and draft a short email to Orion that consolidates our position. If you want, we can run the Tuesday 8/24 11:00 PT sync and I will walk their procurement team through the redlines.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Attachment: Redline-comments_kimberly.pdf (pdf, 46 KB)

Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — MSA redlines + portal requirements (sync notes + next steps)

Jane / team — thanks for the call today. Quick recap and agreed next steps so nothing slips:

Recap from legal/ops sync (8/24)
- Redwood positions: Kimberly will produce a tracked-changes MSA response reflecting the audit-log carve and the commercial compromises discussed (Net30 + one-time 45-day milestone; 3% LD cap).
- Portal mapping: Orion to return the mapping template with exact Coupa field names (PO Number, Remit_To_Email, Tax_ID, GL_Code, Project_Code).
- Signer routing: We confirmed we can attach a 'billing_signer' metadata flag on order ingestion. Mateo: we will accept remit-to != invoice contact provided the remit-to is present in the 'Remit_To' field; ingestion will not reject on that basis.

Action items (owners / due dates)
- Kimberly: Send tracked MSA response to Orion by EOD Thu 8/26. (kimberly.park@redwood.com)
- Orion procurement: Return populated RW_portal_field_mapping_template.xlsx by Mon 8/30. (procure-admin@orionhealth.com)
- Mateo: Confirm minor ingestion docs/guide update for billing_signer flag by Fri 8/27. (mateo.alvarez@redwood.com)
- Aditya: Prepare final DocuSign packet once MSA is agreed; I will create the DocuSign envelope and loop Paul for signature routing.

Deliverables we will attach to the vendor record once complete:
- Final tracked MSA response (PDF)
- Completed portal field mapping (xlsx)
- Signed Order Form (via DocuSign)

If anything above is incorrect or you want us to escalate a commercial item to your leadership before finalizing the MSA, tell me and we'll route accordingly. Otherwise we should be able to complete onboarding within two weeks once we have the mapping and signed MSA.

Best,
